_readme: Per-model rates for cost-per-success reporting. See src/codeagent_eval/pricing.py.
An entry yields a cost only when prompt_per_1k, completion_per_1k, source and as_of are
all present. Anything else reports cost_source=unavailable rather than 0.0, because a
zero is indistinguishable from 'this was free' everywhere it is later displayed.
Rates are per 1,000 tokens. Vendors publish per 1,000,000, so figures here are the
'tiered': true means the vendor prices by input/output length and this entry carries the
MOST EXPENSIVE tier. Estimates from it are flagged upper_bound rather than passed off as
figures. Modelling every tier would need per-call length bucketing; until then an upper
bound that says so beats a point estimate that is wrong for half the trials.
'aliases' exist because vendors keep legacy names alive. Verified against the live API on
2026-08-04: deepseek-chat AND deepseek-reasoner both resolve to deepseek-v4-flash, so
deepseek-reasoner is NOT the pro model despite its name.
CNY-priced models need the top-level usd_per_cny. Without it they report unavailable: no

models.note: Published as $0.14 / $0.0028 / $0.28 per 1M (input cache-miss / cache-hit / output). A peak-hour 2x policy is announced but not yet in effect; re-check before quoting costs from a peak-hour run.
Published as $0.435 / $0.003625 / $0.87 per 1M. Reachable only under this exact name — the deepseek-reasoner alias resolves to v4-flash.
Flagship, 1M context. Published as 8 / 2 / 28 CNY per 1M. Cache storage is free for a limited period. Model-name string unverified: no ZHIPU_API_KEY available to probe /models.

Three length tiers (2/8, 3/14, 4/16 CNY per 1M); the 32-200k tier is used here, so estimates are upper bounds. Long-horizon trials do cross 32k, which is why the cheapest tier would be the wrong single choice.
Three length tiers (0.8/2, 0.8/6, 1.2/8 CNY per 1M); the 32-128k tier is used here.
Listed as free (免费). A genuine zero, unlike an unpriced entry — which is exactly why the two must be distinguishable, and why a missing rate is None rather than 0.0. Weak rung of the ladder.
